A block is attached to a horizontal spring and oscillates on a frictionless surface. The system undergoes simple harmonic motion with a period of and an amplitude of .

a Calculate the angular frequency of the block's vibration. [1]

b Determine the maximum acceleration experienced by the block during its motion. [2]

c Calculate the speed of the block when it is at a displacement of from the equilibrium position. [2]

d State the magnitude of the net force acting on the block as it passes through the equilibrium position. [1]

e Describe the energy transformations that occur as the block moves from the equilibrium position toward the maximum positive displacement. [2]
